title: Machete
description: Lean WordPress plugin that solves common annoyances with as few resources as possible: cookie bar, tracking codes, header cleanup and more.
status_text: Version 5.4 (PHP 8.2+, tested up to WordPress 7.1) is on WordPress.org, and the plugin website is live at machete.nilovelez.com on GitHub Pages. Next: update the Live Preview blueprint.
